primitives.name: Subjective Perceptual Relation
primitives.verbatim_quote: At the moment of having a pseudo-hallucination of sight, the patient feels himself in an entirely different relation to this subjective sensible appearance, from that in which he finds himself whilst subject to a true visual hallucination.
primitives.assumptions: Patient consciousness maintains distinct internal models for subjective and objective perception; R_s ≠ R_o under identical stimulus.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_s ≈ R_o, misidentification occurs (e.g., diagnostic confusion).

layer2.mapping: GSI Bayesian model maps R_s to posterior belief over perceptual authenticity; GSE state transition uses R_s to distinguish cognitive vs. sensory states.
layer2.telemetry: Neuroimaging correlates of self-reported perceptual disconnection.

primitives.name: Phenomenal Authenticity Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: The latter is reality itself ; the former, on the contrary, remains always a subjective phenomenon which the individual commonly regards either as sent to him as a sign of God's grace, or as artificially induced by his secret persecutors .
primitives.assumptions: Authenticity is a binary distinction between internally generated and externally validated percepts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: A_p = 1 for hallucination; A_p = 0 for pseudo-hallucination.

layer2.mapping: GSI constructs A_p as a probabilistic classifier of perceptual origin; GSE uses A_p to modulate behavioral response thresholds.
layer2.telemetry: Self-report validation scores and behavioral consistency measures.

primitives.name: Cognitive Dissonance Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: (After his recovery he called analogous apparitions by the name of 'expressive-plastio ideas.') Accordingly he felt no terror, even though he felt the contact of the claws.
primitives.assumptions: Dissonance arises when perceptual content conflicts with prior knowledge or emotional schema.
primitives.breakdown_regime: D_c = 0 implies alignment between perception and cognition; D_c > 0 implies conflict.

layer2.mapping: GSI evaluates D_c via Bayesian surprise; GSE applies D_c to adjust attentional and motoric engagement.
layer2.telemetry: Physiological arousal markers and behavioral hesitation times.

The core duality lies in distinguishing between hallucinations (objective reality) and pseudo-hallucinations (subjective phenomenology). This is formalized through a relational operator R_s vs. R_o, where R_s represents the patient’s felt relation to a pseudo-hallucination and R_o to a true hallucination. The distinction hinges on the patient's awareness of the perceptual mode, captured by the phenomenal authenticity index A_p. When A_p = 1, the patient perceives the event as real; when A_p = 0, it is recognized as subjective. Cognitive dissonance D_c emerges when the perceived content contradicts known schemas, yet in pseudo-hallucinations, such dissonance is absent due to the patient’s recognition of the subjective nature. These operators form a triadic structure: R_s ↔ A_p ↔ D_c, where each component is conditionally dependent on the others. Failure modes occur when diagnostic confusion conflates R_s with R_o, leading to incorrect classification of perceptual states. The epistemological framework thus requires a layered Bayesian inference engine to track these interdependent variables across time and context.
